verdict.rationale: Claude Code exposes a scriptable CLI, headless/CI modes, hooks, and an Agent SDK that gives 'full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions' for building custom agents, plus direct API-key access bypassing the interactive UI login. However, some features (Remote Control, teleport, browser sessions, GitHub/Slack routing) are described as UI/product integrations rather than documented as fully API-addressable, so parity isn't explicitly claimed end-to-end.
